artifacts.summary: Confirms both Tier Justification defects by direct measurement and rules: fix line 339 by referencing the existing dual-form convention (not restating it), and add a narrowly-scoped advisory lint to validate-artifact.sh (not prose alone) requiring suite_selection_select to actually be run before a Tier Justification claims a suite subset or the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel.

memory_candidates.content: scripts/validate-artifact.sh's plan-type checks already fire automatically at write time via hooks/validate-plan-write.sh's generic PostToolUse invocation. Adding a new advisory check inside validate-artifact.sh's existing plan branch gets write-time enforcement for free -- no new hook or verify-deploy.sh gate entry needed, only the validator and its test suite.

scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh's suite_selection_select function is a pure in-process path-matching loop (no build, no test execution) -- measured at ~50ms wall-clock including library sourcing. When weighing whether to mechanically require a selector invocation before a plan asserts its output, the cost is negligible and not comparable to a full Gate 8 run.
